Title: Non-Linear Transformations with ReLU and GELU
Summary: The video demonstrates how linear inputs are transformed using non-linear activation functions, specifically ReLU and GELU. It explains the ReLU function's behavior—clipping negative values to zero while preserving positive ones—and its role in mimicking an AND gate. The visual and dialogue content together clarify how these functions enable neural networks to model complex, non-linear relationships.
